# rag_from_connections { #mofography.compute.rag_from_connections }

<span class="mg-tag mg-tag-recommended">go-to</span> Go-to RAG builder.

```python
compute.rag_from_connections(connections, maxima, only_use_internal=True)
```

Build a NetworkX region adjacency graph from connection tuples and maxima.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name              | Type   | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | Default    |
|-------------------|--------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| connections       |        | Connections is a list of tuples where each tuple contains information about a connection. Each tuple has the following format: (node_id, is_connected, connection_type)                                                                                                                                                              | _required_ |
| maxima            |        | The `maxima` parameter in the `rag_from_connections` function seems to represent a list of nodes or regions in a graph. It is used to determine the number of nodes in the graph created by the function. Each element in `maxima` likely corresponds to a node in the graph                                                         | _required_ |
| only_use_internal |        | The `only_use_internal` parameter in the `rag_from_connections` function is a boolean parameter that determines whether only internal connections should be used when creating the graph. If `only_use_internal` is set to `True`, only connections with the type 'internal' will be added to the graph, defaults to True (optional) | `True`     |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
|--------|--------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        |        | The function `rag_from_connections` is returning a NetworkX graph `G` that is constructed based on the input connections, maxima, and the optional parameter only_use_internal. The graph `G` is built by adding nodes and edges from the input connections based on certain conditions. The nodes of the graph have a 'labels' attribute assigned to them. |
